flip_era_note: No care-ratio break detected anywhere in the retrievable official series (FY2014-FY2027). OTR renewal era (2003-2013) book volumes are not publicly retrievable (empty folder pages on city site; no Wayback captures pre-2014). The visible story: ratio dips to a trough in FY2018-19 (0.637-0.643, police surge years post-2017 consent-era spending) then climbs steadily to 0.728 (FY2027) - a MODERN-era care tilt (2020→2027), not an OTR-era flip.
